verdict.rationale: Square documents a dedicated Sandbox environment with a Sandbox Payments guide and a Disputes API 'Test in the Sandbox' page. API Explorer, GraphQL Explorer and the MCP server (SANDBOX=true) can all target Sandbox or production resources, which supports a production-mirroring test flow. Most of this evidence is index/link titles rather than detailed content. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of test card numbers for declines and other failure scenarios, detailed description of how closely Sandbox mirrors production, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
